Questions people
actually ask

Are you a smoke shop?

No. We're a vape shop first. We carry accessories too, but the counter is built for helping you vape well.

I'm switching from cigarettes. What should I bring?

Bring what you use now if you have it, and tell us what a typical day looks like. We'll match a setup and nicotine level to your routine and budget.

Can I order online?

Yes, reserve online and pick up in store. We can't ship vapes. You pay and show your ID at pickup.

What if my device stops working?

Bring it in. We'll troubleshoot it with you at the bar.

Do you have rewards?

Yes. Join Five Star at the counter and get points on every visit plus text-only deals.
